thesis: The page is a copper pipe rail: every section hangs from it as a numbered brass tag, and scrolling fills the rail with color as each step of the visit clicks into place.

signature.name: Brass Valve Tags on Pipe Rail
signature.summary: A horizontal copper-colored rule tops every section; numbered brass tags hang from it marking visit steps (01-06), services (price ranges), reviews (stars), and footer (initials). Tags swing in on scroll; rail fills via --sw-p.

motion.intro: Strip slides open from center (clip-path inset) while headline lines mask-reveal upward with 70ms stagger; 900ms total; skippable; text readable at 0ms under reduced motion.
stories: Process rail: pinned ≥640px; tags swing in rotateZ -8→0 staggered 120ms; rail segment fills via --sw-p clip-path; height calc(6×55svh+100svh); reverses on scroll-up; stacked cards with clip reveal under 640px.
Services price stamp: tags stamp in scale .92→1 opacity 0→1 stagger 60ms as grid enters; no pin.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, on links and card titles; @media (hover:hover) only.
